reviewed_boundaries: Guest publication copies only the exact validated bounded partial dump into an O_EXCL/O_NOFOLLOW0600 final regular file; it never calls link(). Output is flushed/fsynced/closed and both complete identities are checked before receipt commit.

Write/flush/fsync/close/hash failures preserve the primary failure, independently attempt owned final removal and expose rollback failure as a fixed Boolean. Preexisting files/symlinks remain untouched.

Before guest boot, actual orchestration invokes only pinned publication_probe code through the same admitted PRoot command prefix, bindings and environment; it creates no database, profile, server, character or game process.

Probe acceptance uses real host lstat single-link regular-file type, exact length/hash and owned process-group/temporary-file cleanup. Host symlink and cleanup refusals are covered using real trivial Linux children with an explicit PRoot stand-in.

Backup child output is bounded and parsed with duplicate rejection, exact keys, strict Boolean types and fixed source-enumerated stage/failure codes; arbitrary child text is never projected. Completed helper refusals retain their safe status after child cleanup.
Actual fixture admission now requires successful publication preflight and strict helper/cleanup success fields, plus all existing fresh source save/full-dump/evidence/cleanup guards.
Source-controlled observer stage/frame-count/finish booleans improve refusal evidence while retaining the original save-before-finish ordering and private input boundary.
